Running opensmile in parallel

Source: vignettes/opensmile_parallel.Rmd
opensmile_parallel.Rmd

This vignette extracts acoustic features from a folder of WAV files with openSMILE, in parallel via furrr. os_extract() can write both an aggregate (functionals) CSV and a low-level-descriptor (per-frame) CSV per file; os_read() later turns either into a tidy tibble.

library(openac)
library(future)
library(furrr)

Confirm that openac can find a working openSMILE install (see set_opensmile() if not, and os_list_configs() for the available feature configs):

check_opensmile()

List the input audio and derive aggregate/LLD output paths for each file:

infiles <- list.files(
  path = "Z:/DynAMoS/Stimuli/Audio",
  pattern = "\\.wav$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

aggfiles <- gsub("/Stimuli/Audio/", "/Features/opensmile/", infiles)
aggfiles <- gsub("\\.wav$", "_agg.csv", aggfiles)
lldfiles <- gsub("_agg\\.csv$", "_lld.csv", aggfiles)

Set a parallel plan and map os_extract() over the input/output triples. The config argument (forwarded to every call) selects the openSMILE feature set:

plan("multisession", workers = 4)

future_pwalk(
  .l = list(infile = infiles, aggfile = aggfiles, lldfile = lldfiles),
  .f = os_extract,
  config = "egemaps/v02/eGeMAPSv02"
)

For the whole-directory case, os_extract_dir() finds and processes every matching file for you. A file that fails does not stop the run: it is warned about, recorded as "failed", and the remaining files still go through. The returned data frame records the outcome of every file, so you can find and re-run just the failures:

os_extract_dir(
  indir = "Z:/DynAMoS/Stimuli/Audio",
  inext = "wav",
  aggdir = "Z:/DynAMoS/Features/opensmile",
  config = "egemaps/v02/eGeMAPSv02",
  recursive = TRUE
)

Confirm the feature files were written, and read one into a tidy tibble:

list.files(path = "Z:/DynAMoS/Features/opensmile", pattern = "\\.csv$")

feats <- os_read("Z:/DynAMoS/Features/opensmile/example_agg.csv")
